g.text: Directions: Take 1 capsule daily with food.
Caution: Do not exceed the recommended dose.
Consult your healthcare provider before use if
you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or
products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning
in children under 6. Keep this product out of
reach of children. In case of accidental
overdose, call a doctor or poison control center
Store in a cool, dry place. Do not use if the
seal under the cap is broken or missing.
